notes: No implementation evidence is claimed by this package.
P0 is the demo-critical slice, P1 is the next expansion, and Production is a live-launch gate.
Official event requirements are summarized with primary sources in architecture section 11.

criteria.title: Pinned clean assembly
criteria.verification: Build the chosen revisions from a clean workspace using the documented bootstrap and dependency lockfile.
criteria.evidence_required: Release manifest, runtime versions and successful command output.

criteria.title: Single data ownership
criteria.verification: Trace each core record and migration to one owner; consumers use documented interfaces.
criteria.evidence_required: Data ownership map and integrated write-path review.

criteria.title: Contract compatibility
criteria.verification: Run valid, invalid, older-version and unknown-field fixtures against producers and consumers.
criteria.evidence_required: Versioned fixtures and compatibility results.

criteria.title: Trusted scope and identity
criteria.verification: Supply forged tenant and project IDs and confirm the server rejects unauthorized scope.
criteria.evidence_required: Negative authorization cases across API, jobs and artifacts.

criteria.title: Typed bounded actions
criteria.verification: Reject unknown dynamic controls, privileged actions and unsupported contract versions.
criteria.evidence_required: Validation errors and allowlisted control fixtures.

criteria.title: Sourced event facts
criteria.verification: Research the selected URL and attach a source or explicit uncertainty to each material fact.
criteria.evidence_required: Event package with field-level provenance and conflicts.

criteria.title: Durable resume
criteria.verification: Interrupt the worker after a completed step and resume from its saved checkpoint.
criteria.evidence_required: Before and after checkpoints and correlated traces.

criteria.title: Bounded recovery
criteria.verification: Trigger a recoverable failure and show attempts, elapsed time and cost limits terminate or resolve it.
criteria.evidence_required: Run showing failure, next action and final outcome.

criteria.title: Untrusted content handling
criteria.verification: Retrieve a page containing instructions to change budgets or tool permissions and confirm they are not acted upon.
criteria.evidence_required: Adversarial source fixture and permission outcome.

criteria.title: Safe URL retrieval
criteria.verification: Reject private-network and unsupported destinations, including a redirected destination.
criteria.evidence_required: URL validation and resource-limit results.

criteria.title: Versioned design edits
criteria.verification: Create a design and one revision with separate hashes, parent linkage and usage references.
criteria.evidence_required: Two design records and a visible comparison.

criteria.title: Approval binds exact output
criteria.verification: Approve one version then change its artwork or event facts; require a new approval.
criteria.evidence_required: Approval binding and stale-version rejection.

criteria.title: Deterministic personalization
criteria.verification: Render multiple names using the selected template and verify exact text and font availability.
criteria.evidence_required: Output variants and content-integrity report.

criteria.title: Print preflight and hashes
criteria.verification: Reject invalid dimensions, bleed or resolution; accept a matching bundle and verify all file hashes.
criteria.evidence_required: Product specification, preflight report and manifest.

criteria.title: Approved asset inputs
criteria.verification: Use only assets with the required approval record in the production bundle.
criteria.evidence_required: Asset provenance and approval references.

criteria.title: Quote separated from purchase
criteria.verification: Obtain a sandbox quote and show it does not create an incurred expense or submitted order.
criteria.evidence_required: Quote record, order state and ledger comparison.

criteria.title: Purchase authorization integrity
criteria.verification: Change quantity, destination, bundle hash, currency or authorized amount and reject the stale authorization.
criteria.evidence_required: Authorization record and invalidation cases.

criteria.title: Ambiguous submission recovery
criteria.verification: Simulate supplier acceptance followed by timeout; resolve its existing identity before any resubmission.
criteria.evidence_required: Attempt history showing one intended supplier order.

criteria.title: Duplicate supplier callback
criteria.verification: Replay the same status notification and confirm no second commercial transition or charge.
criteria.evidence_required: Inbox identity and unchanged effective records.

criteria.title: Attempt level metering
criteria.verification: Join every billable attempt to provider, model, usage, budget scope and correlation ID, or explicit incomplete data.
criteria.evidence_required: Usage-to-attempt report and missing-data coverage.

criteria.title: Duplicate observations
criteria.verification: Import matching direct usage and trace observations twice; effective expense remains one charge.
criteria.evidence_required: Source identity mapping and unchanged ledger totals.

criteria.title: Distinct billed retries
criteria.verification: Execute two distinct billable attempts for one logical operation and retain both costs.
criteria.evidence_required: Two attempt identities with attributed usage.

criteria.title: Unknown billing
criteria.verification: Remove provider usage or time out after dispatch; retain unknown or estimated cost instead of an invented zero.
criteria.evidence_required: Incomplete record, held budget and reconciliation status.

criteria.title: Estimate reconciliation
criteria.verification: Reconcile a $1.00 estimate with a $1.10 confirmed cost; effective spend is $1.10 with traceable adjustment.
criteria.evidence_required: Linked postings and reconciliation evidence.

criteria.title: Aggregate billing coverage
criteria.verification: Import an invoice covering existing request costs without adding those costs again; retain unexplained differences.
criteria.evidence_required: Coverage mapping and unallocated discrepancy record.

criteria.title: Subcent usage precision
criteria.verification: Accumulate small per-call costs without rounding each call to zero.
criteria.evidence_required: Exact intermediate amounts and documented final rounding.

criteria.title: Shared research allocation
criteria.verification: Allocate one research expense across several orders without increasing project expense.
criteria.evidence_required: Original posting and analytical allocation totals.

criteria.title: Revenue and cash classification
criteria.verification: Apply a sale, fee, refund, tax amount, credit, payout and reimbursement with their defined distinct effects.
criteria.evidence_required: Deterministic ledger fixture and expected projections.

criteria.title: Billing mode isolation
criteria.verification: Mix live paid AI tests and simulated sales; actual costs include the paid call while real revenue excludes simulations.
criteria.evidence_required: Filtered projections and source billing modes.

criteria.title: Concurrent project reservations
criteria.verification: Compete for the remaining capacity from two workers and reject any reservation that exceeds the shared limit.
criteria.evidence_required: Concurrent reservation result and conserved capacity.

criteria.title: Reservation consumption
criteria.verification: Settle a held amount into spend and release only its unused portion.
criteria.evidence_required: Before and after budget projection and posting links.

criteria.title: Uncertain in flight cost
criteria.verification: Expire a worker lease during an unresolved provider call and retain the conservative financial hold.
criteria.evidence_required: Lease state, hold state and reconciliation path.

criteria.title: Nested budget scopes
criteria.verification: Check project, workstream, agent and task limits atomically before dispatch.
criteria.evidence_required: Multi-scope contention and settlement results.

criteria.title: Reproducible aggregates
criteria.verification: Open a displayed total and verify its records match the selected period, currency and billing mode.
criteria.evidence_required: Dashboard drilldown and backend projection comparison.

criteria.title: Data quality visibility
criteria.verification: Display absent cash data, estimated costs and unreconciled differences clearly.
criteria.evidence_required: Screenshots showing unknown, estimated and confirmed cases.

criteria.title: Role enforced commands
criteria.verification: Allow member reads while restricting budget and expense commands to authorized roles; record changes.
criteria.evidence_required: Server authorization cases and actor audit history.

criteria.title: CFO summary provenance
criteria.verification: Export a versioned financial summary with definitions, period, assumptions, coverage and source references.
criteria.evidence_required: Export artifact reconciled to the financial projection.

criteria.title: Complete customer journey
criteria.verification: Run URL research through revision, approval, export, sandbox fulfillment and financial reporting.
criteria.evidence_required: One correlated scenario with pinned component revisions.

criteria.title: Comparable improvement
criteria.verification: Evaluate the same representative inputs before and after one change with cost, latency and success criteria.
criteria.evidence_required: Raw results, sample size and configuration differences.

criteria.title: Evidence classification
criteria.verification: Label simulated, sandbox, live, estimated and pending capabilities next to the related demo claims.
criteria.evidence_required: Sanitized evidence index and reviewed narrative.

criteria.title: Secrets and customer data
criteria.verification: Review published evidence and repository history for credentials and unnecessary customer or account details.
criteria.evidence_required: Sanitization review and applicable scanning results.

criteria.title: Neatlogs use
criteria.verification: Record an actual agent run in Neatlogs and provide inspectable traces or sanitized screenshots.
criteria.evidence_required: Neatlogs artifact tied to an evaluated application run.

criteria.title: Entire use
criteria.verification: Capture actual Entire development provenance through checkpoints or repository graph output.
criteria.evidence_required: Entire artifact linked to relevant component revisions.

criteria.title: CFO.ai use
criteria.verification: Build the business plan in CFO.ai using the financial summary and documented assumptions.
criteria.evidence_required: CFO.ai plan covering pricing, costs, revenue and runway; a generic data export alone is insufficient.

criteria.title: Live payment event handling
criteria.verification: Verify payment signatures, repeated and reordered events, refunds and refund allocation before live checkout.
criteria.evidence_required: Payment sandbox suite, reconciliation and launch review.

criteria.title: Operational recovery
criteria.verification: Restore database and artifacts, rehearse interrupted deployment recovery, and verify monitoring ownership.
criteria.evidence_required: Restore record, recovery procedure and alert ownership.

criteria.title: Live supplier validation
criteria.verification: Validate the actual SKU and authorization process before enabling a live purchase.
criteria.evidence_required: Approved sample, confirmed product specification and launch decision.
